services.title: Road Marking (Thermoplastic Paint)
services.shortDescription: High-durability thermoplastic marking solutions for highways and expressways.
services.fullDescription: High durability thermoplastic road marking used for highways, expressways, and urban roads providing long-lasting visibility and safety. Our thermoplastic paints are applied hot and embed highly reflective glass beads for optimal night-time visibility.

services.title: Cat Eyes / Road Stud Installation
services.shortDescription: Reflective road studs used for night visibility and lane guidance.
services.fullDescription: Reflective road studs (Cat Eyes) used for night visibility and lane guidance in all weather conditions. We offer solar, aluminum, and ABS plastic variants installed with strong epoxy resins to withstand heavy traffic loads.

services.title: Reflective Delineators
services.shortDescription: Flexible reflective bollards and delineators for edge marking.
services.fullDescription: Delineators provide essential edge-of-road guidance to drivers, particularly in low-light conditions or bad weather. Our high-grade reflective delineators are UV stabilized and flexible enough to withstand impacts.

services.title: Rumble Strips
services.shortDescription: Thermoplastic and structural rumble strips for speed calming.
services.fullDescription: Rumble strips are an effective traffic calming measure designed to alert distracted or drowsy drivers through tactile vibration and audible rumbling. We install both thermoplastic and milled rumble strips as per IRC standards.

services.title: Kilometer Stones & Hectometer Stones
services.shortDescription: Standardized reinforced concrete milestones and hectometer stones.
services.fullDescription: We manufacture and install pre-cast reinforced concrete Kilometer and Hectometer stones conforming strictly to MoRTH and NHAI specifications, complete with durable retro-reflective lettering.

services.title: Traffic Sign Board Installation
services.shortDescription: Installation of mandatory, cautionary, and informatory sign boards.
services.fullDescription: Professional installation of standardized traffic sign boards on sturdy, anti-corrosive support posts. All boards are designed according to IRC standards to ensure clear road communications and regulatory compliance.

services.title: Reflective Sheeting & Signage Fixing
services.shortDescription: Application of high-intensity reflective sheeting for night-time visibility.
services.fullDescription: High-intensity micro-prismatic reflective sheeting applied to traffic signboards for superior day and night visibility. Our sheeting provides excellent retro-reflectivity even at wide entrance angles.

services.title: Chevron Boards
services.shortDescription: High-visibility alignment signs for sharp curves and roundabouts.
services.fullDescription: Chevron alignment signs guide drivers through sharp curves and changes in road horizontal alignment. Our chevron boards feature highly reflective sheeting and robust back-supports to withstand environmental stresses.

services.title: Object Markers
services.shortDescription: Reflective hazard markers placed on physical road obstructions.
services.fullDescription: Object markers are installed to alert drivers to physical obstructions within or immediately adjacent to the roadway, such as bridge piers, guardrail ends, or central medians.

services.title: Direction & Warning Sign Systems
services.shortDescription: Comprehensive signage systems indicating directions, distances, and warnings.
services.fullDescription: Integrated direction and warning sign systems customized for major highways and urban environments. These large-format signs provide essential guidance and upcoming hazard warnings to motorists.

services.title: W-Beam Crash Barrier Installation
services.shortDescription: W-Beam crash barriers installed for maximum vehicle containment.
services.fullDescription: Supply and professional installation of hot-dip galvanized W-Beam crash barriers. These safety systems absorb impact energy during vehicular collisions, minimizing damage and redirecting vehicles safely.

services.title: Median Barrier Installation
services.shortDescription: Concrete or metal barriers installed in the central median.
services.fullDescription: Installation of robust median barriers designed to prevent cross-median head-on collisions. We offer pre-cast concrete New Jersey barriers and galvanized steel median crash barrier installations.

services.title: Roadside Safety Barriers
services.shortDescription: Flexible and semi-rigid roadside protection barrier systems.
services.fullDescription: Comprehensive roadside safety barrier installations including wire rope safety barriers and structural steel fences. Designed to protect vehicles from roadside hazards like trees, poles, or steep drops.

services.title: Fencing & Protection Systems
services.shortDescription: Security fencing along highways to prevent pedestrian and animal entry.
services.fullDescription: Installation of boundary and median fencing systems to control access and protect traffic flow. Prevents wild animals and pedestrian jaywalking on high-speed expressways, reducing accidents.

services.title: Bollards & Safety Devices
services.shortDescription: Installation of security bollards, speed bumps, and safety devices.
services.fullDescription: Supply and installation of protective bollards, height barriers, and speed calming safety devices. Used to guide vehicular flow, protect structures, and secure pedestrian pathways.

services.title: Street Light Pole Installation
services.shortDescription: Erection of octagonal and swaged steel street light poles.
services.fullDescription: Installation of high-quality hot-dip galvanized octagonal street light poles. Designed to withstand extreme wind loads, providing safe mounting for smart LED roadway lighting.

services.title: Street Light Cabling & Electrical Works
services.shortDescription: Underground cabling, earthing, and feeder pillar installation.
services.fullDescription: Complete electrical infrastructure works for roadway illumination, including trenching, laying of heavy-duty armored cables, installation of smart feeder pillars, and proper system earthing.

services.title: High Mast Lighting Systems
services.shortDescription: Installation of 12m to 30m high mast towers for area lighting.
services.fullDescription: Supply, foundation building, and erection of high mast lighting systems with motorized lowering gears. Delivers uniform, high-intensity illumination for large areas.

services.title: Roadway Lighting Infrastructure
services.shortDescription: Implementation of energy-efficient smart LED roadway lighting.
services.fullDescription: End-to-end roadway lighting projects incorporating energy-saving LED luminaires, brightness control sensors, and central monitoring systems to ensure optimal road lux levels.

services.title: Kerb Stone Installation
services.shortDescription: Laying of pre-cast or cast-in-situ concrete kerb stones.
services.fullDescription: Installation of high-quality concrete kerb stones along road edges and medians. Provides structural support to pavement margins, aids in drainage, and clearly separates vehicular channels.

services.title: Road Furniture Installation
services.shortDescription: Fixing of traffic barriers, delineator posts, and informational kiosks.
services.fullDescription: Installation of secondary road components (road furniture) to maximize comfort, utility, and safety. Includes street benches, litter bins, boundary pillars, and solar traffic beacons.

services.title: Bus Bay Development
services.shortDescription: Civil works for dedicated bus stopping lanes off the main highway.
services.fullDescription: Design and construction of segregated bus bays. Promotes safe passenger boarding and alighting while keeping the main highway lanes free from bus-induced traffic congestion.

services.title: Bus Stop Shelter Installation
services.shortDescription: Fabrication and erection of modern passenger waiting shelters.
services.fullDescription: Manufacturing and erection of premium stainless steel or mild steel bus shelters. Designed to provide weather shelter, seating, and route information to commuters.

services.title: Traffic Management Accessories
services.shortDescription: Supply of traffic cones, plastic barricades, and speed bumps.
services.fullDescription: Supply of highway management safety accessories. Includes highly reflective plastic water-fillable barriers, temporary traffic cones, speed bumps, and solar warning blinkers.

services.title: Median Plantation
services.shortDescription: Planting shrubs and small trees along the highway central median.
services.fullDescription: Horticultural median plantation to reduce opposite-lane headlight glare, control dust, prevent soil erosion, and beautify national highways.

services.title: Highway Landscaping
services.shortDescription: Horticultural and turfing works on highway side slopes.
services.fullDescription: Systematic landscaping and turfing of highway embankments and side slopes. Helps stabilize slopes against rain erosion and provides a green scenic corridor.

services.title: Beautification Works
services.shortDescription: Urban beautification, thematic sculptures, and decorative finishes.
services.fullDescription: Aesthetic enhancement works for public highways and urban junctions, including theme-based paintings, landscaping with fountains, and dynamic lighting installations.

services.title: Joint Sealing
services.shortDescription: Sealing contraction and expansion joints in concrete pavements.
services.fullDescription: Joint sealing of concrete pavements using high-performance elastomeric sealants. Prevents water ingress and debris collection in expansion joints, protecting the road structure.

services.title: Minor Road Repair & Finishing Works
services.shortDescription: Pothole filling, asphalt patch repair, and road finishing.
services.fullDescription: Execution of maintenance works like potholes patching, surface leveling, cleaning, and edge restoration. Ensures a seamless, safe, and clean roadway surface prior to opening.
